claim.quote: We report the first search result for the flux of astrophysical electron antineutrinos for energies O(10) MeV in the gadolinium-loaded Super-Kamiokande (SK) detector. ... No significant excess over the expected background in the observed events is found for the neutrino energies below 31.3 MeV. Thus, the flux upper limits are placed at the 90% confidence level.

date.note: arXiv submission May 2023; published as Astrophys. J. Lett. 951, L27 (2023).

key_value_text.quote: the flux upper limits are placed at the 90% confidence level. The limits and sensitivities are already comparable with the previous SK result with pure-water (22.5 × 2970 kton·day) owing to the enhanced neutron tagging
key_value_text.value: Electron-antineutrino flux upper limits (90% CL) below Ev=31.3 MeV from a 22.5x552 kiloton-day exposure at 0.01% Gd mass concentration, comparable to the earlier pure-water SK limit (22.5x2970 kiloton-day) thanks to improved neutron tagging.

name: SK-Gd first search for astrophysical electron antineutrinos

summary.plain: After gadolinium was added to Super-Kamiokande's water in June 2020 to detect neutrons more efficiently, the collaboration used the initial stage of the new data (August 2020 to June 2022) to search for astrophysical electron antineutrinos. It found no significant excess over the expected background and set upper limits on the flux, which the paper says are already comparable with the previous pure-water result.
summary.technical: Initial stage of SK-Gd (26 Aug 2020 - 1 Jun 2022): 22.5×552 kton·day exposure at 0.01% Gd mass concentration, searching for astrophysical electron antineutrinos via inverse beta decay with enhanced neutron tagging. No significant excess over the expected background below 31.3 MeV; flux upper limits placed at the 90% confidence level. The paper calls this the first search result for the flux of astrophysical electron antineutrinos for energies O(10) MeV in the gadolinium-loaded detector; limits and sensitivities are already comparable with the previous pure-water SK result (22.5×2970 kton·day).

title: Search for astrophysical electron antineutrinos in Super-Kamiokande with 0.01wt% gadolinium-loaded water
why_it_matters: The paper describes this as the first search result for the flux of astrophysical electron antineutrinos for energies O(10) MeV in the gadolinium-loaded Super-Kamiokande detector, and says the limits and sensitivities are already comparable with the previous pure-water result owing to the enhanced neutron tagging.
